summary: Decodes two Huffman-coded symbols from a bitstream into 16-bit results. Reads per-symbol code lengths from the code table at a3, extracts (code length + 1) bits from the bitstream (buffer base this+0x24A4, bit position this+0x24A8) using lookup tables dword_5B4788 and dword_5B4820, advances the bit position per symbol, scales the combined value with tables at a4/a6 and a right-shift by 12, then writes the two decoded words to the output array at a5.

local_names.this: decoder object; this[2345] (this+0x24A4) = bitstream buffer base pointer, this[2346] (this+0x24A8) = current bit position
local_names.a2: symbol index used to address code table, index table and output array
local_names.a3: code table; byte at a3+2*a2 = first symbol code length, byte at a3+2*a2+1 = second symbol code length
local_names.a4: index table; dword at a4+4*a2 and a4+4*a2+128 select the code entry
local_names.a5: output array; words written at a5+2*a2 and a5+2*a2+64
local_names.a6: scale table; dword selected by ((code length + 1) << 6) plus code index
local_names.result: second decoded 16-bit result and return value

operations.description: v7 = 0; default decoded value for the first symbol (taken when its code-length byte is zero)
v8 = *(char*)(a3 + 2*a2); reads the first symbol's code length from the code table at a3
If the code-length byte at a3+2*a2 is nonzero, decode the first symbol from the bitstream; otherwise keep v7 = 0

Bit extraction for first symbol: v9 = dword_5B4788[v8+1] & (byteswap_ulong(*(DWORD*)((this[2346]>>3) + this[2345])) >> -(v8+1+(this[2346]&7))); reads bitstream base (this+0x24A4) and bit position (this+0x24A8), masks with the dword_5B4788 table
this[2346] += v8+1; advances the bitstream bit position (this+0x24A8) by the first symbol's code length plus one

v7 = ((v9 + dword_5B4820[v8]) * *(DWORD*)(a6 + 4*(((v8+1)<<6) + *(DWORD*)(a4 + 4*a2)))) >> 12; combines the dword_5B4820 hash-table base offset with the code index from a4, scales by the a6 table entry, shifts right by 12
*(WORD*)(a5 + 2*a2) = v7; writes the first decoded 16-bit symbol to the output array at a5
result = 0; default decoded value for the second symbol (taken when its code-length byte is zero)
v12 = *(char*)(a3 + 2*a2 + 1); reads the second symbol's code length from the code table at a3
If the code-length byte at a3+2*a2+1 is nonzero, decode the second symbol from the bitstream; otherwise result stays 0

Bit extraction for second symbol: v13 = dword_5B4788[v12+1] & (byteswap_ulong(*(DWORD*)((this[2346]>>3) + this[2345])) >> -(v12+1+(this[2346]&7))); same bitstream read and table mask as the first symbol
this[2346] += v12+1; advances the bitstream bit position (this+0x24A8) by the second symbol's code length plus one
result = ((v13 + dword_5B4820[v12]) * *(DWORD*)(a6 + 4*(((v12+1)<<6) + *(DWORD*)(a4 + 4*a2 + 128)))) >> 12; second symbol scale using code index from a4+4*a2+128
*(WORD*)(a5 + 2*a2 + 64) = result; writes the second decoded 16-bit symbol 64 bytes after the first in the output array
Returns result (the second symbol's decoded value)
